title: Selected Topics in the Cultures of the German-Speaking Countries; Heroes, Helmets, and Huns: German and Germanic Portrayals in Visual Media
description: Exploration of (mis)uses of German(ic)-ness and German(ic) portrayals and portrayals of other cultures and peoples in visual media. What social or aesthetic factors influence portrayals of German(ic) identities in Hollywood cinema/TV, and conversely, of others in Germanophone media? Taught in English.
